title: Oi Oi Oi
blurb: Football-terrace energy compressed into roughly two seconds. The chant is call-and-response by design, so say it once and somebody in the room will answer without having decided to, which converts a collection of individuals into a crowd almost instantly. Genuinely useful at parties, in Discord calls, and anywhere collective enthusiasm needs igniting from cold. It carries no information whatsoever and it works on everybody. The internet's most reliable hype primer, and considerably older than the internet itself.
